## ETF inflows and increased staking drive institutional demand for ETH
US spot Ethereum ETFs saw five consecutive days of net inflows totaling around $746.5 million through September 24, with cumulative net inflows since their launch reaching approximately $13.85 billion, according to Cryptobriefing. This sustained institutional investment via regulated products channels meaningful capital into Ethereum, supporting liquidity and demand. On the same date, BlackRock’s iShares Ethereum Trust led ETF contributions with $26.8 million in new capital, while Ethereum network data from 247wallst showed a net increase in staked ETH as 1.68 million tokens were queued for staking against 154,000 set to be unstaked.
